citations.context: That's why it says in Romans 5, sin and death entered through one man and has passed all men. The only way to save us, literally, is to give us a new breath of life that is sinless and perfect. How does he do that? When we're all conceived in sin, born iniquity, sinful mother, sinful father, both sides were getting a spirit of sinfulness, that's fear in 2 Timothy 1:7. God did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love in Solomon. How does he get that spirit into the species he created in Eden, the incarnation?
citations.creator: mindshift
citations.title: This Alone Defeats Christianity | Original Sin

text.KJV: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
text.WEB: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
